guide.text: Increases HP and Dodge. Wonder Woman shields allies and inflicts [Stunned] on enemies, so high survivability lets her stay in the fight longer to protect the squad.
Increases HP and Dodge. Bane's regeneration thrives on a large HP pool, and more Dodge plus his boosted Physical Defense at low HP makes him even harder to take down.
Increases HP and Dodge. When taking lethal damage, Shazam revives and inflicts [Taunted] on all enemies, and higher HP lets him stay in the fight longer after revival.
Increases HP and Dodge. Doctor Fate stands in the front line, applying shields to allies, and with high HP and Dodge, he can stay longer to protect the squad as a shield Supporter.

Increases HP and Dodge. Scarecrow needs to stay in the front row to keep building [Scare] stacks, and strong survivability ensures he lasts long enough for the stacks to reach their maximum and trigger control.
Increases HP and Dodge. Killer Croc's Ultimate reduces enemy Physical Defense, and with higher HP, he can stay in the front row longer, creating more opportunities for allies to deal physical damage.
Increases HP and Dodge. Martian Manhunter's counterattacks deal spiritual damage, and strong survivability lets him stay on the field longer to monitor allies and counterattack enemies.
Increases HP and Dodge. Queen Hippolyta absorbs damage for allies, and these bonuses let her stay in the fight longer to protect them.
Greatly increases Dodge, HP, and Spiritual Defense, significantly improving survivability.

Increases HP and Dodge. Donna stands in the front row, inflicting marks and permanently reducing targets' Physical Defense. High survivability keeps her alive long enough to stack marks to their maximum and ultimately stun the targets.
Increases HP and Dodge. Wonder Woman Death Metal needs to deal damage continuously in her ultimate form, making high survivability crucial.
Increases HP and Dodge. With control immunity and damage reduction during duels, the Dodge bonus makes Artemis even harder to take down in duels.
Boosts HP and Spiritual Defense. Mr. Freeze relies on high HP and [Absolute Zero Armor] to hold the front line, and this Legacy Piece further increases his toughness and survivability.
Boosts HP, Spiritual Defense, and Dodge.
Boosts HP, Spiritual Defense, and Dodge, helping Beast Boy maintain his defensive buffs.
